skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this image into a 5-second animated video clip — and get animated vid...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video - Deevid.

- Instantly convert static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into animated video clips via AI, with no editing skills required.
- Automatic connection and session setup—just drop images or describe your request to begin.
- Supports export to 1080p MP4, text overlays, audio tracks, aspect ratio adjustments, and batch processing.
- Credits system for usage tracking with simple status checks; anonymous free tier available.
- Handles common video workflows through intent classification for prompts and streamlined cloud rendering (30–90 seconds typical).
- Detailed error handling and user-friendly responses for all major actions.
